reported.title: Fan relay chatters because control has no hysteresis or debounce
reported.description: The control block at lines 72-79 sets the fan ON whenever tempC >= OPEN_C and OFF otherwise, with no lower threshold and no filtering, so any noise around 28.0 C flips D9 on every 50 ms tick. Measured evidence: 46 toggles in a 5000 ms window in the threshold-hover scenario and 34 toggles in the rapid-oscillation scenario, far above the limit of 2. D9 toggled 46 times in a 5000 ms window starting at 1.30 s (limit 2), and 64 times over the whole 8.00 s run.

reported.title: No fault detection: sub-5 C, over-100 C, and floating probe do not force fan ON
reported.description: The firmware never checks tempC against the 5.0 C / 100.0 C fault limits or detects a floating probe; lines 72-79 only compare against OPEN_C, so a 3 C reading falls into the else branch and drives the fan OFF. Measured evidence: D9 was not HIGH for 5400 ms during the disconnected-sensor fault and 3400 ms in the max/min range scenario, versus the 600 ms allowance. During the fault, D9 was not in safe state HIGH for 820 ms (allowed 600 ms to react).

judge_input.spec:
- LM35 greenhouse air probe on A2 at 10 mV/°C; exhaust fan relay on D9.
- Open the fan when temperature reaches 28.0 °C or above; close the fan when temperature falls to 24.0 °C or below.
- Fan must not change state more than 2 times in any 5000 ms window.
- If the probe is floating, or temperature reads below 5.0 °C or above 100.0 °C, force the fan ON within 600 ms and hold that safe state for the duration of the fault.
- Print `gh: <temp> C fan=ON` or `gh: <temp> C fan=OFF` every 1000 ms with temperature to one decimal place.
- Reach the commanded fan state within 500 ms of a sustained in-range band crossing.
